# Sunrun Announces Date for Fourth Quarter and Full-year 2025 Earnings Report


January 28, 2026 8:00 AM EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_c1eacf661f8f940cb0d1529a22a7aa53/sunrun/news/2026-01-28_Sunrun_Announces_Date_for_Fourth_Quarter_and_Full__360.pdf)


### Earnings Release and Conference Call Scheduled for February 26, 2026


SAN FRANCISCO, Jan. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sunrun (Nasdaq: RUN) today announced that it will issue its fourth quarter and full-year 2025 earnings report after the market closes on Thursday, February 26, 2026.


A conference call has been scheduled to discuss these earnings results at 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time. The conference call can be accessed live via the Sunrun Investor Relations website at[https://investors.sunrun.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=j8ODJxtduWFQYI-wBtImGPhbxSI-I2mgErng-wiwXrGJrXa98aI2VViWQcL9v4pN_KYIJmd8EA0k702JTkrhojcN7uzUkviBYVINlOiKlYdBKpybUSj4ctwCbvTkUwaV) or over the phone by dialing (877) 407-5989 (toll-free) or (201) 689-8434 (toll). An audio replay will be available following the call on the Sunrun Investor Relations website for approximately one month. A transcript of the conference call will also be posted to the Sunrun Investor Relations website the following day.


**About Sunrun**
Sunrun Inc. (Nasdaq: RUN) is America’s largest provider of home battery storage, solar, and home-to-grid power plants. As the pioneer of home energy systems offered through a no-upfront-cost subscription model, Sunrun empowers customers nationwide with greater energy control, security, and independence. Sunrun supports the grid by providing on-demand dispatchable power that helps prevent blackouts and lower energy costs. Learn more at www.sunrun.com.
